in_marathi.name: Nimi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nimi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nimitta’, meaning 'that which is adorned, decorated or an indicator'. In Hindu mythology, Nimi is a celestial nymph and a wife of the sage Vedavyasa.

in_bengali.name: Nimi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Adorned, Decorated
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nimi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Nimi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nimitta’, meaning 'that which is adorned, decorated or an indicator'. In Hindu mythology, Nimi is a celestial nymph and a wife of the sage Vedavyasa.
